title: Chronicler game-system template
description: A character-sheet template: the properties a character has and how they are laid out. Authored as YAML or JSON on the Game System admin page.

system.description: The game system's name, e.g. "Monster of the Week". Shown as the template title.

version.description: Integer schema version for this system. Raise it when you change the shape of the template.

properties.description: The stats, tracks, notes and lists a character of this system has.

layout.description: Ordered sections grouping property ids for display. Any property left out falls into a trailing "Other" section.

functions.name: floor
functions.doc: Round down to the nearest whole number — e.g. `floor(7 / 2)` is 3. The usual choice for "round down" game math.

functions.name: ceil
functions.doc: Round up to the nearest whole number — e.g. `ceil(7 / 2)` is 4.

functions.name: round
functions.doc: Round to the nearest whole number — e.g. `round(2.5)` is 3.

functions.name: min
functions.doc: The smallest of the values — e.g. `min(harm["current"], 3)` never exceeds 3.

functions.name: max
functions.doc: The largest of the values — e.g. `max(strength, dexterity)`.

id.description: Stable machine id: lowercase, starts with a letter, letters/digits/underscore only. Referenced by layout and formulas.

label.description: Human-readable name shown on the sheet.

type.description: What kind of value this property holds.
markdownEnumDescriptions: A whole number, optionally bounded by `min`/`max`. Negative ranges render signed (e.g. +2).
A running count from `start`, optionally capped by `max`.
Any subset of `options`, each checked on or off.
A repeatable list of entries, each with its own `fields`. Edited in wp-admin only.

live.description: Players may change this from the play surfaces (front-end / /sheet). Never combine with gm_only.

gm_only.description: Rendered only for a GM; omitted from the page entirely for players and the public.

owner_only.description: Rendered only for the character's author (the owning player) and GMs; omitted from the page entirely for fellow players and the public. Never combine with gm_only.

always_show.description: Keep the property on the sheet even when empty (e.g. Notes) instead of hiding a blank row.

detail.description: System-default note for what the property does (e.g. the moves a rating rolls). Characters may override it.

derived.description: A formula (Symfony Expression Language) computed on every read from other properties. Supported on number and toggle. Never stored or directly editable. Reference properties by bare id; track/counter parts use brackets, e.g. harm["current"]. Functions: floor, ceil, round, min, max.

min.description: Lower bound for a number property.

max.description: Upper bound for a number or counter.

length.description: Number of boxes in a track.

options.description: Choices for a select or checklist.

fields.description: Per-entry fields for a list property.

entry_label.description: Singular noun for one list entry (e.g. "Item").

id.description: Machine id for this field within a list entry.

type.description: Value kind for this list field.
markdownEnumDescriptions: A multi-line text field (compact textarea inside an entry).
A whole number, optionally bounded by `min`/`max`.
An on/off flag. Other fields can appear only when it's on, via `when`.

when.description: An expression (same language as `derived`) over this entry's other fields — the field shows only while it's true. A bare toggle id works: `when: is_weapon`.

properties.description: Property ids placed in this section, in order.

masthead.description: Render inside the header card instead of as a body section.
